The '''2026-27 [[TFF 1. Lig]]''' is the 26th season since the league was established in 2001 and 64th season of the second-level [[association football|football]] league of [[Turkish Football Federation|Turkey]] since its establishment in 1963–64. It will begin on 7 August 2026. The season is set to end on 8 May 2027.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=24 March 2026 |date=6 March 2026 |language=tr |publisher=[[Turkish Football Federation]] |title=Profesyonel Liglerde 2026-2027 Sezonu Başlangıç Tarihleri Belli Oldu |url=https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=204&ftxtID=49875}}<!-- auto-translated from Turkish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
